response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS risk_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), above_average AS (SELECT risk_count FROM type_counts WHERE risk_count > (SELECT AVG(risk_count) FROM type_counts)) SELECT AVG(risk_count) AS average_count, AVG(risk_count - (SELECT AVG(risk_count) FROM type_counts)) AS average_excess FROM above_average;
